name: Changesets
description: A GitHub action to automate releases with Changesets

github-token.description: The GitHub token to use for authentication. Defaults to the GitHub-provided token.

publish.description: The command to use to build and publish packages

version.description: The command to update version, edit CHANGELOG, read and delete changesets. Default to `changeset version` if not provided

cwd.description: Sets the cwd for the node process. Default to `process.cwd()`

commit.description: The commit message. Default to `Version Packages`

title.description: The pull request title. Default to `Version Packages`

setupGitUser.description: Sets up the git user for commits as `"github-actions[bot]"`. Default to `true`

createGithubReleases.description: A boolean value to indicate whether to create Github releases after `publish` or not

commitMode.description: An enum to specify the commit mode. Use "git-cli" to push changes using the Git CLI, or "github-api" to push changes via the GitHub API. When using "github-api"

branch.description: Sets the branch in which the action will run. Default to `github.ref_name` if not provided

prDraft.description: Controls draft PR behavior. Use "create" to create new version PRs as draft, or "always" to also convert existing version PRs back to draft when updating them.
